svg.title: Comparison of previous and proposed 3DGS-based pose refinement methods
svg.desc: Two dashed rounded base frames compare a previous pose refinement pipeline on the left with the proposed pipeline on the right. Each frame contains query images, pose estimator blocks, 3D Gaussian splatting icons, rendered images, rendered depth, arrows, prior wireframe camera poses, and explanatory colored labels. Confirmed SAM photo/icon assets are bound after native SVG draft construction and replace only covered constructed image/icon regions.

g.desc: Origin is the left query image. Downward conduction reaches the pose estimator and bad pose prior; rightward conduction reaches the 3D Gaussian splatting icon, then rendered image and rendered depth. The left panel is organized around a horizontal correspondence axis and a vertical rendered-output trunk.

Origin is the right query image. Downward conduction reaches the pose estimator and bad pose prior; rightward conduction reaches perturbation and importance sampling, then upward to the 3D Gaussian splatting icon. Rendered image and rendered depth are connected by a vertical output trunk. Uncertainty fields feed geometric uncertainty, whose yellow focus arrow points back to the depth image. The section uses left-to-right causal symmetry with feedback toward the focus region.
